measurements.how_measured: visually estimated proportion of flat red-orange versus illustrated and other flat fills across full poster
measurements.statement: about 50-55% of the frame is flat red-orange empty background in upper-left and lower band

measurements.how_measured: compared stroke weight, letter width versus height, presence of serifs, and inter-letter space on headline versus supporting lines
measurements.statement: headline MARS is heavy wide low-contrast sans with tight letterspacing; top VISIT THE and bottom taglines are light narrow tall condensed sans with wide letterspacing, no serifs

measurements.how_measured: compared vertical cap-height of giant MARS letters to smallest VISIT THE and bottom tagline letters
measurements.statement: largest text height : smallest text height is about 9 to 1

measurements.how_measured: estimated bounding box of interlocking flat shapes from rover at left to black mountains at right and from yellow block at top to blue band at mid-lower
measurements.statement: dense geometric illustration cluster occupies middle ~60% of height and ~90% of width, centered slightly right of frame

measurements.how_measured: counted distinct flat fills with no gradients: red, mustard-yellow, cream, black, purple-magenta, medium blue plus white accents
measurements.statement: palette is 6 flat hues with no gradients or shading, red dominant

measurements.how_measured: divided frame into vertical thirds and noted where legible display text occurs versus image-only area
measurements.statement: all large text is in top ~10% flush left and bottom ~20% centered; middle ~65% has no large text

hypotheses.statement: Extreme scale contrast between giant bottom title and tiny framing lines creates a clear top-to-bottom hierarchy that anchors the busy center.
A dense interlocking central image mass set against large areas of empty flat red creates tension and lets the collage pop with optimistic poster energy.
A strictly flat limited palette unifies disparate rover, helmet, and architecture fragments into one cohesive futuristic-nostalgic mood.

relations.rule: Keep display title cap-height about 9x the smallest supporting text to preserve anchor hierarchy.
Keep middle 60% image-only with no large text, confine text to top edge zone and bottom band.
Limit palette to about 6 flat hues with one dominant flat field covering about half the frame and no gradients.

fragile_if_changed: Replacing the flat dominant red field and limited flat-color geometric illustration with photographic shading or gradients would most destroy the bold retro travel-poster character.

skin_measured.how_measured: k-means (6 clusters) on the sent pixels for bg/fg; accent = median of strongly saturated mid-lightness pixels (s>0.45, 0.2<l<0.8) inside region 'bottom MARS title and taglines', excluding pixels within RGB distance 60 of bg because the background itself is saturated
